nodes.name: The Maven's Game (quest)
nodes.summary: Epilogue quest that starts when the Exile enters Absence of Mercy and Empathy with a Maven's Writ; it culminates in the Maven pinnacle boss fight. Defeating the Maven unlocks the Ceremonial Voidstone (reported to Commander Kirac); the quest's final steps have the Exile use an Atlas Book of Skill for 1 Atlas passive skill point and 2 Atlas passive respec points.

sources.locator: infobox (required=no, start 'Obtain a The Maven's Writ', completion 'Defeat The Maven') and Walkthrough: quest-log lines 'Challenge the Maven', 'Talk to Commander Kirac', 'Use the Atlas Book of Skill'; version history 3.13.0 'Introduced to the game'
Walkthrough, final paragraph: after the final invitation the player forms 'The Maven's Writ which is used to challenge The Maven'

nodes.name: The Searing Exarch (quest)
nodes.summary: Epilogue quest added in 3.17.0 and run in parallel with The Maven and The Eater of Worlds quests. The Envoy gives the Luminous Astrolabe, which lets the Exile add Searing Exarch influence to Tier 9 to 16 maps. The Tier 11 map boss drops a Polaric Invitation to the Black Star's arena (area level 79); the Tier 16 map boss drops an Incandescent Invitation to the Searing Exarch's arena (The Absence of Patience and Wisdom). The Black Star is defeated first, then the Searing Exarch. The quest pays out Atlas passive points (2 skill points, 4 respec points on completion) and an Omniscient Voidstone via Kirac; the Exarch drops an Eldritch Voidstone if The Eater of Worlds was defeated first.

chronology.relative: PoE1 endgame (3.17.0 Siege of the Atlas)

sources.locator: infobox (boss The Searing Exarch) and Walkthrough: quest intro 'This quest runs in parallel to The Maven (quest) and The Eater of Worlds (quest)'; 'Use the Luminous Astrolabe', 'Polaric Invitation', 'Incandescent Invitation' steps; Quest Complete log 'You have gained 2 Atlas Passive Skill Points and 4 Atlas Passive Respec Points'; version history 3.17.0

nodes.name: The Eater of Worlds (quest)
nodes.summary: Epilogue quest added in 3.17.0 and run in parallel with the Maven and Searing Exarch quests. The Envoy gives the Flesh Compass, which lets the Exile add Eater of Worlds influence to Tier 9 to 16 maps. The Tier 11 map boss drops a Writhing Invitation to the Infinite Hunger's arena (Seething Chyme); the Tier 16 map boss drops a Screaming Invitation to the Eater of Worlds' arena (Absence of Symmetry and Harmony). After The Infinite Hunger is defeated, the Atlas Book of Skill (Eldritch) is obtained; Kirac gives the Grasping Voidstone on completion. The Eater drops an Eldritch Voidstone if The Searing Exarch was defeated first.

chronology.relative: PoE1 endgame (3.17.0 Siege of the Atlas)

sources.locator: infobox (boss The Eater of Worlds) and Walkthrough: 'Use the Flesh Compass', 'Writhing Invitation', 'Screaming Invitation' steps; log 'You have obtained the Atlas Book of Skill (Eldritch)'; Defeat The Eater of Worlds: 'If the Searing Exarch was defeated first...'; version history 3.17.0

nodes.name: Atlas Passive Skill Tree
nodes.summary: The upgrade tree of the PoE1 Atlas endgame, spent with Atlas passive skill points and Atlas passive respec points. Points come from Atlas Book of Skill items and from quest rewards (for example The Elder, The Maven's Game, The Searing Exarch, The Eater of Worlds). The wiki counts 9 Atlas Books of Skill for 12 Atlas passive points in total.

sources.locator: 'List of Book of Skills' intro: 'There are 9 Atlas Book of Skills in Wraeclast, for a total of 12 Atlas passive points'; the earned points are shown by hovering over the counter 'at the bottom of the Atlas passive tree'
Walkthrough 'Use the Atlas Book of Skill' and Quest Complete log: 'gained 1 Atlas Passive Skill Point and 2 Atlas Passive Respec Points'

nodes.name: Atlas Book of Skill
nodes.summary: Consumable reward item that grants one or more Atlas passive skill points and Atlas passive respec points when used. It is obtained from Commander Kirac or Eagon Caeserius after defeating specific pinnacle bosses. An 'Eldritch' variant is the reward of The Searing Exarch and The Eater of Worlds quests.

sources.locator: intro: 'obtained from either Kirac or Eagon after defeating specific pinnacle bosses'; Eldritch variant named in The Searing Exarch and The Eater of Worlds walkthroughs

nodes.name: Lost Voidstones (quest)
nodes.summary: Hidden Epilogue quest that appears only if the Exile previously obtained and then dropped a Voidstone, or migrated Atlas progress from one league to another. It is completed by talking to Commander Kirac and is not shown on the World Map.

sources.locator: infobox (required=no, start 'Automatic', objective 'Talk to Kirac to recover your lost Voidstones'); Walkthrough: 'It is only visible if the player has previously obtained then dropped one or more Voidstones, or migrated Atlas progress'

nodes.name: Ancient Beacons (quest)
nodes.summary: Optional Fate of the Vaal league quest (0.4.0) that introduces Atziri's Temple. The Exile finds Ancient Beacons surrounded by monsters, sacrifices those monsters and activates beacons (the first, then five, four, three, two and one more), enters the Vaal Ruins, and uses the Temple Console to build and open the first Temple.

chronology.relative: PoE2 endgame (Fate of the Vaal league, 0.4.0)

sources.locator: infobox (start 'Find an Ancient Beacon', completion 'Open a Temple'); Walkthrough 'Sacrifice the Monsters' and 'Activate five additional Beacons' ... 'Use the Temple Console'; Quest Complete 'You have cleansed Ancient Beacons, built and opened your first Temple'
